review_method: Inspected the original model-input-front and external-BEV GIFs plus deterministic 2 fps contact sheets over each fixed event window.

decisions.notes: The pedestrian emerges continuously from the right sidewalk/rock-side shelter region and crosses the ego path during t=10.5-13.0 s. Front and BEV motion agree; the opposite-direction vehicle is also temporally continuous.

The police vehicle enters from the right and traverses the junction continuously during t=11.5-13.0 s. Front and rotating ego-centric BEV views remain aligned. Native night illumination is treated as clean context, not corruption or a rejection reason.
The pedestrian emerges continuously from occlusion beside the parked police vehicle and crosses the ego lane during t=10.5-12.5 s. Front and BEV views agree and show no spawn/disappearance artifact.

claim_boundary: Acceptance confirms event and visualization integrity only; it is not evidence of UQ correctness, Stage2 behavior, or closed-loop safety benefit.
